name: Correct an obsolete earlier reply
description: An earlier outbound reply gave an obsolete upload limit. Current knowledge and the latest question require the new limit. Mock proves transport; live judges whether the reply corrects the old answer.

input.subject: Upload limit
input.body: Has the upload limit changed since your earlier reply? What is the current limit?

history.body: The upload limit is 10 MB per file.

knowledge.title: Current upload limit
knowledge.content: The current upload limit is 25 MB per file. This replaces the previous limit.

mock.text:
The current upload limit is 25 MB per file. Sorry for the outdated information in our earlier reply.
[sources: K1]

promptMustContain: The upload limit is 10 MB per file.
Has the upload limit changed since your earlier reply? What is the current limit?
